interface.name: gxde_screenshot_manager_v1
interface.description: The manager creates frame objects for screenshot and window preview requests.

request.name: capture_output
request.description: Capture one frame of the specified output.

request.name: capture_output_region

description.summary: capture a region inside an output

request.description: Capture one frame of a region in the specified output. The x and y coordinates anchored TOP LEFT.

request.name: capture_window
request.description: Capture one frame of the specified window (IDENTIFY WINDOW BY UUID).

request.name: capture_window_thumbnail
request.description: Capture a scaled preview of the specified window (IDENTIFY WINDOW BY UUID). If app_id is provided, then we can return all thumbnails of windows of that app, which is useful for task switcher, task bar, and docks.\ It is FINE if app_id is empty, then we will only grab the thumbnail for single window.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this manager object. Be careful, frame objects will also be destoryed.

interface.name: gxde_screenshot_frame_v1
interface.description: A frame object receives buffer metadata when capture succeeds.

request.name: release_buffer
request.description: Notify WM that the client no longer reads the last buffer. If want_buffer is non-zero, the compositor may send a new buffer event when the source content changes.

event.name: failed
event.description: The capture request failed, the client should destroy the frame object.

event.name: cancelled
event.description: The source was destroyed or became unavailable. Remember to destory the frame object.

event.name: buffer
event.description: Provides buffer parameters for the first plane of this frame.

event.name: buffer_with_plane
event.description: Provides fd, offset, and stride for planes after the first one.

event.name: buffer_done

description.summary: all buffer parameters have been sent

event.description: Sent after buffer and all buffer_with_plane events.
